title: PRJ-2 — Projects Customisation And Apple Notes Migration Delivery
summary: add Projects-only folder metadata and controls, migrate the exported Apple Notes corpus into the collection, and report reconciliation gaps
content_html:
PRJ-2 — Projects Customisation And Apple Notes Migration Delivery

Status And Purpose

Proposed as PRJ-2 after the local-link contract in PRJ-1.

This delivery turns dotlineform/projects into a useful folder-notes collection. It adds one Manage-only registered customisation, one optional folder_path metadata field, and a checked-in one-off migration for the exported Apple Notes project corpus. It does not add a generic batch-import or folder-seeding UI.

Complete Outcome

Every Project document can store and edit one normalized Folder Link. The exact value is written to source front matter and projected into that document's namespaced row in local manage-manifest.json. The Projects report can show the link and offer its exact Open in Finder action while the shared default report and public manifest stay unchanged.

A write-free migration plan imports every exported Markdown file as a separate Project document. A reviewed mapping from each exported top-level project folder to a current projects/ folder supplies folder_path where there is an exact or explicitly accepted correspondence. Several documents may share the same path. Notes without a current-folder match remain valid pathless Project documents for later Project State review.

Apply consumes the exact reviewed plan, creates only its preallocated targets, and can resume without allocating new identities or duplicating committed documents. The migration produces a gap and exception report; it does not consolidate notes, create empty documents for uncovered folders, or synchronize the collection with the filesystem.

Observed Migration Inventory

The planning snapshot at $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/Notes export - 2026-05-18/iCloud/dotlineform/projects contains:

  • 240 Markdown files across 201 exported top-level project folders;
  • 206 current direct child folders under projects/;
  • 192 exact top-level folder-name matches, covering 228 Markdown files;
  • 12 Markdown files in 9 unmatched exported folders;
  • 19 exported folders containing more than one Markdown file; and
  • 346 referenced exported assets.

The migration planner must recompute and hash the real inventory rather than treat these counts as immutable. The current exceptional-reference snapshot includes one applenotes: link, nine likely unrecoverable sandbox: links, and referenced RTF and TXT files outside the ordinary attachment allowlist.

Fixed Design Notes

  • The configured collection selects a known projects customisation; no runtime branch infers behavior from scope, sub-scope, title, or filename.
  • folder_path is optional convenience metadata, not identity, validity, or a lifecycle condition.
  • folder_path belongs only to Project document source and the namespaced Docs Viewer Manage projection. PRJ-2 neither reads nor changes Studio Works and adds no Studio field, UI control, payload, hook, or service dependency.
  • Project-specific row data lives only in the customisation namespace of the local Manage manifest.
  • The ordinary/public manifest remains {doc_id, title} and imports no Manage customisation module.
  • Edit Metadata reads and writes the exact validated Project document.
  • Documents may be created with no path or with an in-root relative path that does not yet exist.
  • The path validity and activation root is $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/; a Project document may deliberately represent a contained folder outside projects/.
  • The migration source is the exact dated Apple Notes export above. It does not scan other Notes exports or treat the general import staging area as migration input.
  • Folder association uses the exported top-level project folder as provenance. Exact names may be proposed automatically; every unmatched folder requires an explicit reviewed mapping or an explicit no-current-folder result. There is no fuzzy matching.
  • Every Markdown file is a separate Project document. All documents beneath one reviewed exported folder may deliberately share the same folder_path.
  • Existing collection documents are not overwritten, consolidated, or adopted by title or body similarity. Any metadata update to an existing document is a separate exact-target action.
  • Supported referenced assets use the existing import media pipeline. Unsupported, missing, applenotes:, and sandbox: references are preserved where safe and reported; PRJ-2 does not infer replacement targets or attempt link recovery.
  • Pathless imported documents and current folders with no Project document are retained as visible reconciliation gaps for the later Project State report.
  • Existing, missing, duplicate, and prospective documents remain untouched unless they are exact confirmed mutation targets.

Delivery Discipline

PRJ-2 should remain one registered sub-scope customisation plus one checked-in migration command under docs-viewer/migrations/. The command reuses existing Apple Notes normalization, media, import planning/apply, atomic document creation, and confined rebuild owners. It must not write source through a parallel document writer or introduce another manifest format, generic registry, folder synchronization service, batch-import endpoint, or general bulk-workflow framework.

PRJ-2.0 must record the exact proposed files, reused owners, durable migration plan/receipt shape, and rough production/test diff size. If the implementation materially exceeds the one-field projector, exact-target controls, and one-source migration described here, pause for review and move the extra capability into a separately accepted delivery. Line count is a scope signal, not a reason to compress or duplicate code.

Rough Delivery Steps

PRJ-2.0 — Freeze Customisation And Migration Contracts

  • [ ] Trace current dotlineform/projects config, default report host, manifests, metadata schema/modal, document creation, and sub-scope customisation registries.
  • [ ] Freeze folder_path source validation, Manage-manifest row shape, browser descriptor, row/detail controls, and public exclusion.
  • [ ] Trace the ordinary Markdown/Apple Notes normalization, media rewrite, import plan/apply, document creation, rebuild, and existing migration seams.
  • [ ] Freeze export inventory ownership, one-file/one-document title rules, stable identity allocation, source and asset hashes, reviewed top-level folder mapping, pathless output, exception reporting, and result locations.
  • [ ] Freeze exact-plan apply, resumable receipt, collision refusal, supported asset handling, and committed rebuild retry behavior.
  • [ ] Record the exact file list, reused seams, rough production/test diff estimate, and any proposed expansion before implementation approval.

Checkpoint: one reviewed contract covers a manually created prospective document, a linked existing document, several imported documents sharing one path, an unmatched pathless import, an exceptional reference, and an existing collection document that the migration leaves untouched.

PRJ-2.1 — Project Metadata And Projection

  • [ ] Register the Manage-only Projects Python and browser customisation pair.
  • [ ] Add exact-target folder_path read/write through the existing metadata owner and PRJ-1 normalizer.
  • [ ] Project only validated namespaced row data into manage-manifest.json.
  • [ ] Render Project-specific link state and exact Open in Finder without changing default membership or navigation.

PRJ-2.2 — Apple Notes Migration Plan And Apply

  • [ ] Add a checked-in one-off migration command with explicit plan and apply modes and the exact dotlineform/projects destination.
  • [ ] Plan every Markdown file and referenced asset without collection writes, allocate stable document identities, hash the inputs, and emit a sanitized review report plus machine-readable plan.
  • [ ] Propose exact folder-name mappings, require explicit decisions for all unmatched folders, allow multiple documents to share one path, and retain explicit no-current-folder results without inventing a match.
  • [ ] Reuse the existing Apple Notes normalization and supported-media rewrite per Markdown file even when its export folder contains other Markdown files.
  • [ ] Report preserved unsupported, missing, applenotes:, and sandbox: references without recovery guesses or silent loss.
  • [ ] Apply only the exact reviewed create-only plan. Revalidation rejects changed inputs and unexpected target or media collisions.
  • [ ] Persist enough exact receipt state to recognize already committed plan targets on retry, fail on mismatched content, and never allocate replacement identities or create duplicates.
  • [ ] Rebuild the collection once after the planned source writes. A post-commit rebuild failure retries the rebuild only.

PRJ-2.3 — Apply Real Migration And Review Gaps

  • [ ] Run focused config, projector, metadata, customisation registry, migration-plan, exact-target, resume, exception-report, public-boundary, lint, and whitespace checks.
  • [ ] Plan the real dated export before any apply and review representative odd names, explicit unmatched-folder decisions, multi-note folders, source/media collisions, and exceptional references.
  • [ ] After explicit acceptance, apply the exact plan and inspect the real default/list/detail behavior at realistic density.
  • [ ] Produce the reconciliation report: current folders with zero, one, or several associated documents; pathless imports; unmatched export folders; untouched existing documents; and unresolved asset/link exceptions.
  • [ ] Transfer the shipped extension contract to the durable sub-scope customisation architecture and retain Projects-specific product meaning in the Projects Concept.

Not In Scope

  • continuous folder/document synchronization;
  • a generic batch-import UI, API, or reusable bulk-workflow framework;
  • automatic empty-document creation for current folders without an imported note;
  • automatic note consolidation or existing-document deduplication;
  • recovery or inferred replacement of applenotes: and sandbox: links;
  • automatic rename, merge, delete, or stale-link repair;
  • Work or Series reconciliation;
  • Project State report generation;
  • Resolver Tokens; or
  • public folder metadata.

Completion Evidence

  • Manual and imported Project documents share the same front-matter and manifest contract.
  • Default and public sub-scope payloads remain byte-compatible and folder-blind.
  • The customisation uses exact document targets and handles missing/duplicate paths as visible states.
  • The migration plan is write-free, identifies every source and target, and records explicit pathless and exceptional-reference results.
  • Apply is create-only for the exact reviewed plan; retry recognizes committed targets and cannot allocate replacements or duplicate documents.
  • The final report distinguishes zero, one, many, and no-current-folder states without repairing them ahead of Project State.
  • Real collection review distinguishes generated projection evidence from manual UI acceptance.
